traits.name: Twisting Tail
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger A creature within reach of the jungle drake's stinger uses a move action or leaves a square during a move action it's using. Effect The jungle drake Strikes the target with its stinger. If it hits, the jungle drake disrupts the creature's action.

traits.name: Draconic Frenzy
traits.text: ⬺ The jungle drake makes one fangs Strike and two stinger Strikes in any order.

traits.name: Jungle Drake Venom
traits.text: (poison); Saving Throw DC 24 Fortitude. Maximum Duration 6 rounds Stage 1 1d6 (1d6) poison and enfeebled 1 (1 round) Stage 2 1d6 (1d6) poison and enfeebled 2 (1 round)

traits.name: Predatory Grab
traits.text: As Grab, but the jungle drake's Grab does not end if it moves away. Instead, it carries the grabbed creature with it. A jungle drake can't Fly while grabbing a creature unless that creature can also Fly.

traits.name: Speed Surge
traits.text: ⬻ Frequency three times per day Effect The jungle drake Strides or Flies twice.

traits.name: Spit Venom
traits.text: ⬺ (poison); A jungle drake can spit a sticky glob of its venom to a range of 50 feet that explodes in a 10-foot burst. Those in the burst must succeed at a DC 24 Reflex save or be exposed to jungle drake venom. The jungle drake can't use Spit Venom again for 1d6 (1d6) rounds.

traits.name: Woodland Stride
traits.text: The jungle drake ignores difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain from non-magical foliage.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ fangs +17 Damage 2d10+7 (2d10+7) piercing plus predatory grab

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ stinger +17 (reach 10 feet); Damage 2d6+7 (2d6+7) piercing plus jungle drake venom
